role_in_parent: Provides the geometric meaning of the affine reparameterization and the left-endpoint value.
statement_nl: Let n be a positive integer and j an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1. For every real t with 0 <= t < 1, the point T_{n,j}(t) lies in I_{n,j}, and T_{n,j}(0) = j/n.

domain_restrictions: n is a positive integer (so n >= 1)
j is an integer satisfying 0 <= j <= n - 1
t is a real number satisfying 0 <= t < 1
T_{n,j}(t) is defined for each such t
I_{n,j} is a well-defined subset of the ambient space that contains points of the form T_{n,j}(t)
T_{n,j}(0) is defined and takes value equal to the real number j divided by n
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every positive integer n and every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, for every real t with 0 <= t < 1: (1) the point T_{n,j}(t) lies in I_{n,j}, and (2) T_{n,j}(0) equals j divided by n.
quantifier_order: for all integers j with 0 <= j <= n - 1
for all real numbers t with 0 <= t < 1
